cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We're claiming for your lost bag. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've told me both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Was the bag beside you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So both fit. Tell me the boarding bit again: did the bag come back out with you?

mechanism: A guides its old pupil through a timeline exercise, treating apparently incompatible accounts as details to compare rather than a lie to punish.
confusable: Not forcing a confession: new evidence lets A acknowledge both accounts fit and then test the remaining missing step.
comparison: Parcel shape versus movement of lost property.
seedUse: D126 bus/coffee/four/payment/driver; S05 practiced step-by-step recounting.
